findings.title: Retry-count cleanup deletes non-SMS reminders
findings.body: The deleteMany uses OR: [SMS + past scheduledDate, retryCount > 1]. The second branch has no method filter, so any WorkflowReminder with retryCount > 1 will be deleted regardless of method (EMAIL, WHATSAPP, SMS). Today only the SMS path increments the column so the blast radius is limited, but the predicate is wrong and will delete unrelated reminder types as soon as they ever use retryCount. It should be ANDed with method: SMS.

findings.title: Missing sendTo/message never increments retryCount, infinite retry remains
findings.body: Retry increment only happens inside if (message?.length && sendTo) in the else branch, or in the catch block. If sendTo is empty (e.g. missing smsReminderNumber / sendTo number) or message is empty, the loop iteration does nothing - no scheduled flag, no retryCount increment, no delete. That reminder will be re-fetched by every cron run until its scheduledDate passes, which is exactly the endless rescheduling for invalid/missing numbers this PR claims to fix.

findings.title: Non-atomic retryCount increment from stale read
findings.body: The code updates retryCount with data: { retryCount: reminder.retryCount + 1 } using the value read earlier in findMany. If two cron instances / overlapping runs process the same reminder, one increment is lost. Use an atomic increment operation instead of read-modify-write so retries are counted correctly.
